How to set a price for your trip 
How to set a price for your trip 
 September 25, 2026 
Table of contents 
🇨🇦  · Applies to Canada only · Click here for US version 
Legality of pricing 
To comply with local carpooling laws , drivers must ensure that a Poparide passenger's contribution does not exceed the vehicle's shareable (operating) costs, such as gas, insurance, and maintenance. 
Our pricing model considers these costs, and aims to allow drivers to ask for a fair contribution on their trip based on the distance and current gas prices. 
Maximum price per km 
In order to maintain fair pricing, Poparide currently sets a maximum price of 20 cents per kilometre. 
The maximum price is based on the average cost of gas in Canada and gives drivers room to ask for a higher contribution if their vehicle has a higher miles per gallon (MPG) rating. 
Note: For most routes, the average price per kilometre is 12 to 15 cents. 
Recommended prices 
Recommended prices on each route are calculated based on the: 
distance of the trip and the cost of driving 
pricing data for other trips on Poparide 
prices offered by our competition 
To encourage bookings, it's recommended that drivers set their price at or below the recommended rate. Charging too much discourages passengers who might then look for cheaper alternatives.
